days.intro: Welcome to the back room! Customers are clicking Add to Cart as we speak. Let's get their orders out.
Express shipping is live. It converts great, but those customers do not like to wait.
Last week a mug arrived in more pieces than it left in. Fragile items get bubble wrap now.
We ship worldwide from today. And the Hog Mansion is back in stock: only two left!
Flash sale! Twenty percent off everything and the checkout button is on fire. All paws on deck.
